newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Q2 data confirm growth boosting jobs-Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain Q2 data confirm growth boosting jobs-Montoro.

text.p: Spain's second-quarter jobs data confirm that growth is boosting employment, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro told journalists on Wednesday.
"The numbers confirm that economic growth is really translating into the creation of employment," Montoro told journalists at the presentation of a business survey.
Earlier on Wednesday, Spain said second-quarter unemployment fell to 20.94 percent from 21.49 percent in the first quarter.
